atlas.runner.editorHint: Tab inserts 4 spaces. Press Esc, then Tab, to leave. Ctrl+Enter runs the code.
atlas.runner.input: Input for input(), one line per read
atlas.runner.firstRunNote: The first run downloads Python, about 10 MB.
atlas.runner.queued: Waiting for another code block to finish…
atlas.runner.longRunning: This code has run for over {{seconds}} seconds. If it is stuck, press Stop.
atlas.runner.stopped: Stopped. You can edit the code and run it again.
atlas.runner.loadFailed: Could not load Python. Check your connection and try again.
atlas.runner.noOutput: The program finished without printing anything.
atlas.runner.outputTruncated: The output is too long, so only the beginning is shown.
atlas.runner.figuresTruncated: Only the first {{count}} figures are shown.
atlas.runner.stdinMissing: The code calls input(), but this block has no input data. On this page, input() cannot ask you.
atlas.runner.hintNameError: Python does not know this name. Check the spelling, or check that the variable is set on an earlier line.
atlas.runner.hintSyntaxError: The statement breaks Python's grammar. Check brackets, colons and quotes on this line or the line above.
atlas.runner.hintIndentationError: The indentation is off. Lines in one block need the same indent, usually 4 spaces.
atlas.runner.hintTypeError: An operation or function got the wrong type, for example a number plus a string.
atlas.runner.hintValueError: The type is right but the value is not, for example array sizes that do not match.
atlas.runner.hintIndexError: The index is past the end of the list or array. Python counts from 0.
atlas.runner.hintKeyError: This key is not in the dict, or this column is not in the table.
atlas.runner.hintAttributeError: This object has no such attribute or method. Check the spelling and the object's type.
atlas.runner.hintModuleNotFoundError: This library is not available on the page. Only numpy, pandas, matplotlib, scipy and scikit-learn are.
atlas.runner.hintEOFError: The code reads input() more times than there are lines in the input box.
atlas.runner.hintGeneric: Read the last line of the error message: it names the error and the reason.
